facts.fact: [verified-repo] GATE (ORG.md, 'The gate — the one rule the referee enforces'): a strategy may be called an edge only if (1) its rules were written in ledger.csv BEFORE its first backtest; (2) out-of-sample, after realistic costs, the bootstrap 5th percentile of mean R per trade is above zero; (3) it survives a one-sided Bonferroni correction alpha = 0.05/N, N = sum of the ledger count column (every hypothesis and variant ever tested, by anyone, any day); (4) per firm, at its R/trade and trades/day, it passes that firm's evaluation more often than it blows it and reaches the 20% goal in the fleet model; always report R per trade AND trades per day. Day-2 additions: only a hypothesis pre-registered in ledger.csv the evening before may be run; a hypothesis whose day filter can see the trade day itself must also be run with an ex-ante filter and the worse result decides.

Treat these families as CLOSED and never re-run them without a brand-new pre-registered row and genuinely fresh data: bot SMC/ICT/TJR rules and all parameter/replay grids (H0001-H0004, H0010, H0016, H0003's 100 hypotheses); Beat-the-Market noise-area momentum (H0005/H0011); S&P/SPY/NQ last-half-hour momentum incl. gamma-conditioned (H0006, H0019); intraday IBS reversal (H0013/14); overnight-gap fade (H0012/17); 5-min ORB (H0020); 1-min and 30-min VWAP/TWAP trend on single indices (H0021/22) and across 19 CFDs (D4); FOMC/CPI/NFP/ISM/PCE/retail-sales intraday rules (E2-01..12); daily FX/CFD trend, carry, EWMAC and their stacks at CFD swap costs (D2); crypto TSMOM (L/S, long/flat, BTC/ETH, vol-managed), 1h EMA trend, XS momentum 7d/28d, funding carry, cash-and-carry, hour-of-day (D3); FTMO stock-CFD reversal/PEAD/overnight/tug-of-war books (E1); crypto+US100 equal-risk ensemble (F1); S&P turn-of-month (H0023); RSI(2)/3-down buy-the-dip on index CFDs with/without SMA200, long and L/S (G2); opportunistic insider purchases (H0018); VIX term-structure carry at safe-list firms (G1, no product).

Pre-registration procedure to copy exactly: write every variant as a row in agents/prereg/<dept>.csv with the ledger columns (id, date, owner, hypothesis, count, rules_fixed_before_test, data, result_mean_R, result_p5_R, passed_gate, notes), a 'PRE-REGISTERED' prefix, a count-0 common-rules row if needed, exact data sources with sha256 pins, the IS/OOS split, costs, the gate and the decision rule; commit and push BEFORE any backtest code exists (commit order is the proof); scripts must refuse to run on market data without a registered id; state the unit of result fields explicitly in notes ('result fields = ...').

Gate to apply per variant: OOS net mean > 0 with t = min(iid t, Newey-West lag-10 t) >= the wave bar; bootstrap p5 = min(10,000 iid, 10,000 block-20 (seed 0)) > 0 (trade-level tests: day-clustered bootstrap with >= 50/alpha draws); truncation test (positions through random cut dates identical when later data is deleted; >= 20-50 cuts, or every day/bar for intraday) and perturbation test pass; alpha t vs a matched beta benchmark >= bar; held-out markets net > 0 where breadth is claimed; realistic 1x costs with the 2x result reported beside; the worse of execution-lag variants (lag 1 vs lag 2; close vs next-open; as-written vs ex-ante eligibility) decides; the headline is chosen by in-sample Sharpe before any OOS number is read; nothing passes 'on 1x only'.

Out-of-sample means a period or market set never used to choose any rule; write the split before touching data; do not use IS for anything but the headline choice and fixed scalars; report per-year tables, win rate, trades/yr AND R per trade (or bp/day), gross and net, Sharpe, maxDD, worst day, and the firm-rule fit (5% daily loss, 10% static max loss) at the volatility the target needs.

Report every result against the economic target in the same breath: FTMO Swing 100K needs net Sharpe ~2.4 at 12% vol, ~1.9 at 15%, ~1.5 at 20% for $20k/slot-yr (F2-09); futures-firm intraday fleets needed +0.28R/trade at 3 trades/day (or +0.78R at 1/day) in the Apex-era model; zero-edge fee-option value must be subtracted (FTMO S=0 pays $1.8k-$5.0k/yr in D1, ~$1.2k stressed) before calling anything edge; skew tricks and barrier/CPPI sizing do not reduce the Sharpe needed.

Eligibility and signals may use only information available at the decision minute: never require the trade day's own bar count, its 15:59 bar, or any post-entry bar; run the future-truncation harness (delete every bar after the entry minute, nothing about day d may change) on every intraday test before reading results.

Clock and calendar conventions: label bars by OPEN time; HistData 1m files are New York local time WITH DST (not fixed EST); Oanda is UTC; Databento ts_event is UTC; FirstRate is NY-naive; verify any new file's clock with an outcome-free diagnostic (mean |1m return| by minute around known opens in winter vs summer) before any return is computed; use the CME equity-index calendar for ES/NQ and drop CME-only sessions; NYSE half-days have 210 RTH bars.

Futures rolls: Databento .c.0 (calendar roll) has NO RTH bars on quarterly expiry Fridays and sits in the illiquid expiring contract for the last ~6 sessions (volume 0.09-0.32x); FirstRate/hindsight roll 1-3 days earlier; decide in the prereg whether roll weeks are dropped (Mon-Fri of 3rd-Friday week plus following Monday) or spliced to the next contract, and never change it after results; when buying Databento data prefer explicit contract symbols or volume-rolled continuous series over .c.0 for intraday tests.

Never mix dividend-adjusted and raw price files; index opens before 2010 and some Yahoo opens are stale (treat open == previous close as invalid); SPXUSD 1m misses RTH minutes on most 2012-13 days; Binance keeps stale rows after delisting and funding intervals changed to 4h/1h in 2023; keep data in scratch, never commit files > 1 MB, pin by sha256, log licence status (FirstRate/Databento third-party copies are a licence hold until Itamar rules).

Cost floors to use unless measured better: ES 0.6 pt RT (or 0.30 pt/side), NQ 0.375 pt per unit traded (flip = 2 units), SPY 0.5 bp/unit; CFD per-side 0.5-1.5 bp FX/indices, 1 bp gold, 2.5 bp WTI, 8 bp natgas, plus FTMO swaps (index long ~-8%/yr US, -6.5% EU, -4.9% JP225; stocks long -8.4% short -6.6%; crypto -30%/yr both sides; FX markup ~1%/yr); crypto perps 7 bp/side + actual funding, spot 9.5 bp/side; always run 2x cost; FTMO publishes no spreads so every spread is an assumption to be stated.

Statistics hygiene: cluster by trading day (cluster-robust SE around the trade mean); never use a 5,000-draw bootstrap for a 0.05/N quantile; convert horizons with days-with-a-trade (~14/month), not 21 trading days; a one-sided 0.05/N bound needs ~3x the sample of a two-sided 95% bound; a max-minus-min across groups is a selection; scale by past volatility only; perturbation tests do not catch loader errors, so hand-check rate lags, quote directions, sign conventions, swap on gross notional and cost timing.

Organizational rules that worked: independent verifier re-implements from the written spec without reading the head's code and must match within a pre-stated tolerance; a red team whose default is 'refuted' attacks both positive and negative verdicts; every number traces to code that ran or a cited page; blocked hosts are reported, never routed around; no purchases, sign-ups, firm contact or money movement by agents; a bug fix after results is allowed only with before/after numbers in the report; post-hoc slices (e.g. US-only G2, crypto weekends, TJR wide stops) are information, never findings.

Beta is not edge: compare every long-biased result to buy-and-hold of the same basket scaled to the same exposure (G2 lost to a Sharpe-0.72 basket; crypto TSMOM equals BTC B&H; TOM lost to B&H Sharpe 0.76); remove the 20 best days as a fragility check.

Prop-fit check is part of the gate: the stack's worst day scaled to target vol must stay inside the firm's daily-loss limit (F1 -6.74% and G2 -14% to -28% days breach FTMO's 5%) and maxDD inside the 10% static limit; report breach counts over rolling windows.
